subject: Clockwork demo window for March exec run — DST-aware options
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@acmeai.com>, Lena Müller <lena.mueller@finpulse.de>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@tokyohealth.jp>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Clockwork demo window for March exec run — DST-aware options

Hi Amit / Lena / Kenji —

Thanks again for coordinating an executive run of the Clockwork integration. We want to lock a 60-minute slot in March (execs + engineering leads + our product leads). A few constraints to surface up front:

- We’re aiming for the week of March 28–Apr 1 to align with internal readiness.
- US DST starts Sun Mar 14; EU DST starts Sun Mar 28. That creates a 1-hour step for parts of Europe on Mar 28, which could affect a cross-hemisphere window if we pick that date.
- Ideally we pick a time that keeps morning/evening windows reasonable for all three regions (US west coast, Central Europe, JST).

Could you each indicate availability preferences across these two target slots (we’ll pick one and have a 20-min canary rehearsal the day before):

Option A: Tue Mar 29 at 08:00 PDT / 16:00 CET / 00:00 JST (Mar 30) — earlier for EU, late for JP
Option B: Wed Mar 30 at 11:00 PDT / 19:00 CET / 03:00 JST (Mar 31) — later but still awkward for JP
Option C: Thu Mar 31 at 06:00 PDT / 14:00 CET / 22:00 JST — late evening JP, early US

If a slot on Mon Mar 28 works better we can avoid the EU DST shift but that week is tight for some exec calendars.

Attached: demo-runbook-v1.pdf (walkthrough + slack triggers) and a first draft mutual-action-plan. I’ll consolidate and send a calendar proposal once I have preferences.

Thanks —
Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Lena Müller <lena.mueller@finpulse.de>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Amit Shah <amit@acmeai.com>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@tokyohealth.jp>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 15:47:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Clockwork demo window for March exec run — DST-aware options

Hi Mina —

Thanks for the clear options. Quick note from the Europe side: Mar 28 is the DST change here (clocks jump forward at 01:00 UTC). For our execs, anything after ~16:30 CET on Mar 28 becomes unstable because their calendars sometimes reflect the old offset depending on corporate calendar syncs.

Preferences:
- Option C (Thu Mar 31 at 14:00 CET) is easiest for our leadership — it keeps the meeting squarely in working hours and avoids the Mar 28 ambiguity.
- Option A would work only if Kenji can tolerate midnight.

If you must pick Mar 29, please confirm that calendar invites will be explicit about time zones (e.g., include both local times) and we’ll do a 10-min canary with our calendar admin.

Best,
Lena

--
Lena Müller
Head of Partnerships, FinPulse GmbH
lena.mueller@finpulse.de

From: Amit Shah <amit@acmeai.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Lena Müller <lena.mueller@finpulse.de>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@tokyohealth.jp>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clockwork demo window for March exec run — DST-aware options

Mina —

Appreciate the options. From our side (US west coast) midday/early afternoon works best so execs don’t have to join too early. Option B (11:00 PDT) is the cleanest for us.

If we pick Option C it forces some of our execs to join at 06:00 which is borderline. We’d be okay with Option C if there’s a clear recording plan and a short follow-up for any questions.

Also, can we lock a 20-min tech rehearsal the day before with our platform engineer and Redwood’s serving lead? Having the runbook rehearsed on a technical environment identical to the live demo reduces risk.

Thanks —
Amit

--
Amit Shah
VP Product, AcmeAI
amit@acmeai.com | +1 206-555-0188

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Amit Shah <amit@acmeai.com>, Lena Müller <lena.mueller@finpulse.de>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@tokyohealth.jp>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clockwork demo window for March exec run — DST-aware options

Thanks everyone — 

Summary of constraints I’m tracking:
- Acme prefers Option B (11:00 PDT).
- FinPulse prefers Option C (14:00 CET / Thu Mar 31).
- Japan prefers something that avoids 03:00–05:00 JST if possible.

Realistically the overlap window that gives acceptable local times is narrow. Propose we do this:

Primary: Thu Mar 31 at 06:00 PDT / 14:00 CET / 22:00 JST (Option C) — keeps EU in business hours and gives JP a late evening slot.
Fallback: Wed Mar 30 at 11:00 PDT / 19:00 CET / 03:00 JST (Option B) — only if JP confirms late-night availability.

Operational asks if we pick Primary:
- 20-min canary rehearsal Wed Mar 30 at 06:30 PDT with Acme platform engineer + Redwood serving lead (internal lineup: Soojin to run serving checks).
- Recording + concise 3-bullet follow-up for execs who can’t attend.
- Add explicit time-zone strings in the calendar invite and include UTC times.

If that works I’ll draft the calendar invite with a DocuSign NDA link for cross-team sharing and lock the rehearsal.

-Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions Architecture | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@tokyohealth.jp>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lena Müller <lena.mueller@finpulse.de>, Amit Shah <amit@acmeai.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Feb 2027 09:20:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Clockwork demo window for March exec run — DST-aware options

Hello Mina and team —

Thanks for outlining options. For TokyoHealth the preference is to avoid extremely late nights; 22:00 JST on Thu Mar 31 is acceptable for one-time exec attendance but we would prefer the rehearsal (if possible) to be earlier in the evening local time so our engineers are rested.

We can tentatively confirm Primary (Thu Mar 31 at 22:00 JST) provided:
- The rehearsal is Wed Mar 30 at 22:00 JST (which maps to Wed 06:00 PDT) — that time works for our platform engineer.
- The calendar invite explicitly includes: local time, UTC, and a note: "EU shifts to DST on Mar 28 — confirm your calendar shows 14:00 CET/UTC+1 or 15:00 CEST/UTC+2".

If you send the invite with both UTC and each participant’s local time we’ll lock it on our side.

Regards,
Kenji

--
Kenji Sato
Chief Engineering Officer | TokyoHealth
kenji.sato@tokyohealth.jp

Subject: Re: Clockwork demo window for March exec run — DST-aware options

All —

Thanks for the quick replies and the constraints — this is helpful. Based on the feedback the team is comfortable locking the Primary option:

Final: Thu 31 Mar 2027, 06:00 PDT / 14:00 CET (note DST: CET -> CEST on Mar 28) / 22:00 JST — 60 minutes
Rehearsal: Wed 30 Mar 2027, 06:30 PDT (20 minutes) — platform + serving lead only

Action items I will take on now:
- Send a calendar invite that includes local times and UTC, explicitly notes the EU DST transition, and pins the meeting timezone to UTC to avoid client-side calendar conversion issues.
- Attach runbook + short checklist in the invite.
- Add a DocuSign NDA link and mark the rehearsal invite as "technical only".

Soojin / Karthik — can you please confirm who will be the Redwood tech leads in the rehearsal so I can include them in the calendar?

Amit / Lena / Kenji — please reply with any final no-go items within 48 hours; otherwise I’ll publish the invite by EOD Monday.

Thanks —
Mina
